correctness.rationale: The actual source RESULT.md symmetrizes arbitrary feasible doubly stochastic matrices first over left translations, then conjugation, preserving the class-union support and using convexity of the operator norm. With class masses x,y,z on the order-three and two order-five classes, A5 characters give Fourier scalars (phi*y+phi_prime*z)/3, (phi_prime*y+phi*z)/3, (2*x-1)/4, -x/5. Since the two degree-three scalars sum (1-x)/3, mean-zero norm is at least max((1-x)/6,x/5), uniquely balanced at x=5/11,y=z=3/11. This is the uniform 44-neighbor kernel; its 3,3,4,5 irreducible dimension-square multiplicities yield 1(1),1/11(18),-1/44(16),-1/11(25), and symmetric normality yields exact k-step norm 11^-k. Unique central optimizer only; unrestricted uniqueness not claimed.
